messages:
elaine_sales: Quick heads-up — FinCo wants a POC convo today. They require EU-only processing for PII, but want APAC region for non-PII low-latency. Pricing/ops questions: how do we handle tenant pinning, KMS residency, and egress charge routing? Can @matt_ops or @zoe_eng confirm feasible options and rough delta on cost?

matt_ops: Thanks Elaine. Short answer: tenant pin to EU is doable for hosted/dedicated via regional routing policy. Fallback options exist but need to be explicit in the SOW.

zoe_eng: @elaine_sales @matt_ops adding details: we support three routing policies today: strict-pin (fail if EU capacity unavailable), pin-with-fallback (route to EU-compatible model in another EU zone), and best-effort (serve from closest region). PII toggle must be applied at request-level so we can route only those tokens to EU-resident infra.

elaine_sales: Good. FinCo also asked about BYOK / customer-managed KMS in-region. What's our stance? They will push hard on key locality.

amy_legal: For BYOK we need Private or Dedicated (with enterprise contract). We have an EU KMS integration flow (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and HSM-backed options — but BYOK on hosted tier is not supported today. I'll attach the checklist after the call.

zoe_eng: Correct. Quick config snippet we typically share with customers:
```
routing_policy: pin-with-fallback
pii_marker: request.metadata.pii=true
kms_mode: customer-managed (Dedicated/Private only)
allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
```
This is what the POC config will look like.

matt_ops: On egress/pricing: if they require strict EU residency + isolated KMS we need Dedicated or Private — that drives a material price delta. Rough numbers for a POC: add a reserved-capacity uplift (~+25-40% over hosted consumptive pricing) and a fixed onboarding fee for KMS attestation. I can pull exact numbers if you want a quote.

elaine_sales: Yes please, Matt — need a ballpark to share before the customer call. Also they asked whether we list subprocessors (where logs/telemetry might go). Can you confirm the subprocessor list visibility?

amy_legal: We provide a subprocessor list and can sign an attestation. For EU-only customers we limit telemetry retention and can exclude non-EU analytics endpoints under contract. Need SOC/GDPR addendum for that.

zoe_eng: Operational notes: prefix/KV cache could leak metadata unless masked — make sure FinCo flags any fields that should be excluded from caching. For POC start we recommend: small traffic sample, enable pii_marker, and no caching for PII paths.

elaine_sales: Awesome. Action items: @matt_ops — send ballpark pricing + onboarding delta by EOD. @amy_legal — send subprocessor attestation template and BYOK checklist. @zoe_eng — share the POC config snippet and caching guidance in a gdoc. I'll prep the customer-facing summary.

matt_ops: On it. Ballpark numbers in a thread by 18:00.

amy_legal: Will share templates after quick review, ETA tomorrow AM.

zoe_eng: I'll drop the gdoc link here when done.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 today 22:30 UTC — might impact canary capacity for strict-pin policy.

elaine_sales: Good catch @deploy-bot — I'll flag that to FinCo during the call so they understand potential canary constraints.

elaine_sales: Thanks team, I'll run the call and loop in engineering during the POC setup.
